entries.summary: Siemens Österreich and Ars Electronica ran the Siemens Artist in Residence programme from 2001, in which artists made works at the Ars Electronica Futurelab, later shown at the Siemens_artLab in Vienna in 2005.
entries.evidence: Seit 2001 konnten insgesamt vier Künstler ihre Visionen und Konzepte im Ars Electronica Futurelab realisieren

entries.summary: Siemens Smart Infrastructure supplied the access control, fire protection and intruder detection for the 2021 extension and developed a touch warning sensor for artworks together with the museum.
entries.evidence: provided various access control, fire protection system, intruder detection and picture alarm products

entries.summary: The free public screenings of festival operas and concerts on the Kapitelplatz carry its name, the Siemens Fest>Spiel>Nächte, since 2002, with about 70,000 visitors a year.
entries.evidence: Seit 2002 werden gemeinsam mit den Partnern Siemens, ORF Salzburg und UNITEL ausgewählte Höhepunkte

entries.summary: Its Simcenter Digital Twin software was used in the “Sound of Science” simulation, which replicates the acoustics of the festival halls digitally.
entries.evidence: mithilfe von Simcenter Digital Twin den Akustikcharakter der Festspielhäuser digital repliziert

entries.summary: An exclusive NIGO x Nike Air Force 1 launch was held at the museum when the NIGO exhibition opened in spring 2026, and the museum shop alone sold a co-branded Nike apparel line.
entries.evidence: exclusive NIGO x Nike Air Force 1 launch held at the museum

entries.summary: The museum carries the group's name: its Chinese name, 华侨城当代艺术中心, means OCT Contemporary Art Center.
The museum's art and research library is named the Wipro Library. The Wipro Foundation grant supported construction of the museum building, which opened in February 2023.
entries.evidence: Supporting the construction of the museum building

entries.summary: The grant covers visits by Wipro's customers to the museum as part of Wipro's customer relationship work.
entries.evidence: Facilitating Wipro’s customers visits to the museum as a part of Wipro’s customer relationship engagement.

entries.summary: At the Benefactor level it is listed at ($10,000+), the museum gives free admission for all company employees, two Executive Memberships, an invitation to the annual Director’s Dinner and custom volunteer opportunities.
entries.evidence: Free Museum admission for all of your company’s employees

entries.summary: The 2026 master sponsorship gives InfinitePay brand presence in the exhibition spaces of the museum's three buildings, exclusive guided tours and educational activities.
entries.evidence: inclui presença da marca em espaços expositivos, visitas guiadas exclusivas, ações educativas
